title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Says US Companies Should 'Absolutely' Use Chinese AI Models Despite Bessent’s Sanctions Warning
key_facts: Huang spoke to Axios on Wednesday 7 Oct 2026.
He said US companies should 'absolutely' use Chinese AI models and downplayed IP-theft and distillation fears, while saying firms should still answer for breaking contracts or user privacy.
Bessent said on Tuesday the US could sanction overseas models found stealing from US companies and that it finds US model watermarks on many Chinese models.
Huang called for Anthropic's Claude Mythos to be offered as a service to everyone.
He said 'Free AI should be great for chips' and for data centers.
He said the markets and Washington misunderstood the 'Kimi shock'.
quote_evidence: "There's no scenario where China runs U.S. companies off the road. Zero possibility," he said.
"If we see, especially, that overseas models are stealing from our great companies, we have the ability to sanction them because of this theft," he said on Tuesday.
"Free AI should be great for hardware. Free AI should be great for chips. Free AI should be great for data centers," he said.
why_it_matters_hint: A leading chip maker contradicts the administration's tougher stance on Chinese AI.
notes: Stocktwits wrote the piece from an Axios interview; Axios not read directly. Huang sells chips to AI firms, so his view reflects his company's interest too.
